backtest_note: Reference Norway rankings are explicitly not clean historical predictions because the v1/v2 migration did not begin from a precommitted exhaustive candidate universe. Prospective runs must freeze candidate universe, strategy version, as_of and evidence availability before outcomes.
missing_private_data_policy: Authenticated/private fields remain null/MISSING_REQUIRED and block promotion; they are never imputed.
finland_backtest_note: Finland reference fill is exploratory and explicitly non-backtest-eligible because no precommitted exhaustive candidate universe existed before evidence collection. Prospective Finland runs must freeze candidate universe, strategy version, as_of, available_at evidence set and prediction before outcomes.
